description: Pay-per-call tasks on AIProx (aiprox.dev), paid in Bitcoin Lightning sats. Use it when the user asks to run a task through AIProx or to buy one of its capabilities. Orchestrate is 50 sats: one task, up to 4 steps on AIProx's own bots, one summarized answer. Single capabilities have their own prices: AI web answer 35, page text extract 20, summarize 40, translate 40. Payment is a LightningProx spend token or L402.
